title: AI Email Automation for Agencies

decisions.decision: Separated drafting from sending. AI never sends; a human approval token is mandatory.
Enforced guardrails in a code node rather than trusting the prompt: no links, no calendar links, no spam phrases, strict length limits.
Added a dedicated error workflow with Slack alerting and a Postgres dead-letter table.
Targeted agencies and service businesses instead of generic e-commerce lifecycle automation.
